description: A titled grid of equally sized choices (style gallery, equation structures and symbols, symbol palette): one section with a visible heading that names its group, a fixed column count, a roving tab stop and arrow keys that respect the columns. Every choice is a native button and applies at once.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the section.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Columns of the grid. Defaults to 6.

parameters.name: Heading
parameters.description: Visible heading of the section; also the accessible name of the group.

parameters.name: IsSelected
parameters.description: Whether one choice is the current one (aria-pressed and the active modifier).

parameters.name: ItemClass
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on every choice.

parameters.name: ItemTestId
parameters.description: The test id of one choice.

parameters.name: OnSelect
parameters.description: Raised when a choice is activated.

parameters.name: SectionTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the section root.

parameters.name: SheetColumns
parameters.description: Columns while the grid sits in a bottom sheet (a narrow, mobile layout). Defaults to 4; never more than Columns.
